capabilities: Watch configured folders for new or changed notes
Read a frontmatter property from each note
Create target pages from a template, replacing {{title}} with the property value
Detect duplicate source URLs and mark, trash, or ignore them
Optionally clean up target pages whose property value no longer appears
disambiguation: Not a tagging or search tool; it only creates or cleans up target pages named after a frontmatter property value.
extras: README documents privacy posture (no network access, single-file source), SLSA build provenance verification, and requires Obsidian 1.14.5 or newer; flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically create index or topic pages for notes based on a property value, so clippings inboxes and similar folders need manual upkeep of index notes.
summary: Rule-driven automation that watches folders, reads a frontmatter property on each note, and keeps a matching topic page alive in a target folder.
